barWidget.description: Icon badge for pending Arch repo, AUR, mise, plugin, and theme updates, with a hover tooltip listing every pending package and its old -> new version. Nerd Font package icon when clean, package-variant icon plus count when updates are waiting. Click to update, middle-click to refresh.

description: Shows pending Arch repo, AUR, mise, shell plugin, and theme updates as a Nerd Font icon badge: package icon when clean, package-variant icon plus count when updates are waiting. Hover lists every pending package per category with its old -> new version; click runs the updater, middle-click refreshes the check.
name: arch-updates
